sources.title: AD5791 Rev. F
sources.facts: 20-bit DAC; B-grade one-LSB maximum INL at +/-10 V references, 0 to 105 C; settling statements depend on step/buffer.
sources.scope: Supplier limits under conditions; affine and reference errors require calibration

sources.title: LTC2500-32 Rev. B
sources.facts: 32-bit filtered output; no-latency composite includes 24 differential bits; 2 ppm max INL; averaging DF1024 at 1MHz has 1.024 ms spacing and 512 us listed delay.
sources.scope: Group delay is not automatically an absolute history bound; no noise-tail certificate
